postprocess: Sprites with checkerboard RGB previews were converted to real RGBA using tools/remove_checkerboard.py; original v1 files are in archive-v1.
purpose: 减少生成素材的视觉噪声，保持既有角色、站位与玩法。
style_prompt: Clean Japanese animation game art with deliberate shape design. Build each form from a few broad, smooth, connected color masses. Use one base tone, one grouped shadow tone and at most one restrained highlight per material. Show volume with shape and lighting, not surface texture. Keep warm light and cool shadows clearly separated without muddy brown-green mottling. Preserve crisp readable silhouettes while keeping internal edges sparse. Concentrate detail only on identity-defining features. Assess readability at actual gameplay size rather than at full image resolution. Avoid photographic texture, grain, stippling, crosshatching, distressed surfaces, tiny repeated highlights and all-over micro-detail. Simplify by redrawing forms, not by blurring the image.
reference_policy: Reference for identity and composition only; explicitly replace texture density. Do not request fidelity to the old rendering style.
cutout_fallback_prompt: Preserve the newly simplified character exactly. Replace only the background with perfectly flat solid #FF00FF, including all silhouette gaps. No shadow, gradient, checkerboard or magenta spill. Do not add details to the character.
